note: Subagent definitions for the spec lead's team. The factory turns each member into a harness-native subagent for the spec lead's run: its prompt is the member's SKILL.md, the shared contract, and a child run brief the factory writes (skills/_shared/factory-contract.md, section 4), and its model and effort come from factory.config.ts under configRole. These four names are the only agent types the lead's run may start, enforced before launch. reads and writes are file names in the run's outDir, or in taskDir for a file carried over on a revision; the child brief gives them as absolute paths. runsWhen is the design's trigger table: a fresh session is required for each new or affected decision, with explicit inheritance on revisions as described in the run contract. See docs/skills-delivery.md.

members.name: architect
members.description: Decides the system shape, module boundaries, data ownership, and key interfaces for a new project or a tier L change, and writes architecture.md. Start it first, alone.

members.name: infra
members.description: Chooses hosting, database, auth, email, queues, payments, analytics, CI, and observability from the infra catalog for the decided architecture, and writes infra.md. Start it after architecture.md exists, in parallel with frontend.

members.name: frontend
members.description: Decides layout, navigation, components, typography, states, and frontend libraries from the frontend catalog, and writes frontend.md. Start it after architecture.md exists, in parallel with infra.

members.name: threat-modeler
members.description: Models threats against the decided design and the draft acceptance criteria, maps each to a mitigation, and writes threat-model.md. Start it last, after every other decision file exists.
